en: Black‑and‑white photograph postcard showing a large stone Renaissance-style portal in a stucco wall. The arched doorway has heavy rusticated blocks and carved ornament around the frame. Above the lintel is a frieze with decorative reliefs and a circular medallion bearing an emblem or monogram, flanked by sculpted figures. Higher up are three arched openings: two filled, one open, with columns and classical detailing. A man in dark clothing stands partly in the shadow of the passageway. On the right side of the façade is a small rectangular plaque with the number 25.
